description:
User-agreed boundaries: Outgoing adds only attachments list; no delivery wrapper, plan or selection errors. Selection failures stay in tool feedback. Channel owns transient plan/runtime; existing DeliveryConfirmation and Engine confirmation event remain authoritative. Preserve current capability-snapshot + FileSettings + TransportRequirements.resolve contract and shared UI. Source ../zaq-feat-channel-files at 8d987fa5c is reference, not a wholesale cherry-pick. Current branch has different SDK/provider dependencies and no AttachDocuments. Existing adapter declaration work zaq-h2i.4 and Telegram limitation zaq-1lw.21 must be reused. No production edits or external publication authorized by this planning task. Existing old epic zaq-1lw is historical source and is not closed or overwritten. Preserve old grouping/execution semantics as proposed baseline pending review. No new BO UI in scope; backend integration journeys are appropriate, reassess browser E2E if scope expands.

Current scope correction from Jad: this PR must not create or port AttachDocuments. No tool registration, tool schemas, request-local Agent selection accumulator, or related tool-driven workflow/notification wiring. Tasks .8 and .10 are closed as removed from scope, not completed implementation. Outgoing.attachments and its canonical builder remain in .2. Validate delivery with supplied attachment Records through the existing Channel entrypoint; no new selection tool is required. Producer selection failures are outside this PR.
